breakdown.description: Requesting twoPhaseEulerFoam solver but the case setup is configured for multiphaseEulerFoam with different phase configuration and interaction models
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retains 'twoPhaseEulerFoam' as the solver (first line: 'Run a 2D gas-liquid bubble column simulation with twoPhaseEulerFoam in OpenFOAM'), whereas the ground truth requires 'multiphaseEulerFoam'. The agent did not identify or correct this inconsistency despite the case setup (blending schemes, multiple drag/virtual mass/heat transfer configurations for dispersedIn and segregatedWith) being characteristic of multiphaseEulerFoam.
